verdict.rationale: PostHog's experiments docs say you define variants and pick the metrics you care about. PostHog then randomizes users, tracks exposures, and runs Bayesian or frequentist statistics, so the core of the story is first-party documented. Experiments also appear as a 40-tool MCP category and as Experiment status in PostHog Desktop. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how significance and confidence are shown on the results view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of experiment results reporting.
